6765.title: Monaco token scope and alpha adaptation
6765.rootCauseOneLine: The theme adapter forwards TextMate selectors without YAML Monarch aliases and passes token alpha that Monaco discards.

prReviews.topFinding: The open linked PR addresses both verified mechanisms; its branch and tests were not run.

6765.proposedFix: Alias YAML TextMate selectors to Monarch tokens with explicit-selector precedence, and composite token alpha over the effective editor background. Existing linked PR #6764 prevents a duplicate fix.
6765.caveats: Original synthetic palette, not the reporter’s exact theme or a full BB server. Second clean reproduction performed by the same agent; lazy-tokenization timing corrected before final evidence. Reproduction scripts and assertions are inline per the report repository’s publishing policy.
